name: sw-kit
description: Software behavior contracts, engineering direction, production code quality, and codebase maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Turn requirements into sound software and maintain it well.
interface.longDescription: Provides software behavior specification, technical direction, production code quality, and codebase lifecycle maintenance.
defaultPrompt: Use $sw-kit:spec to turn a product or user request into a technology-neutral software behavior contract.
Use $sw-kit:engineering for architecture, data model, technology, integration, migration, or operations decisions.
Use $sw-kit:code to implement, refactor, test, or review production code within the selected technical direction.
Use $sw-kit:maintenance to audit and plan safe reduction of dependency, deprecation, dead-code, drift, and debt costs.
